title.en: Secretary of State, Vote-by-mail ballot rejection reasons, June 2, 2026 primary
Secretary of State, Vote-by-mail ballot rejection reasons, November 4, 2025 statewide special election
Secretary of State, Vote-by-mail ballot rejection reasons, November 5, 2024 general election

explanation.en: The guide does not say which election is meant. Secretary of State rejection-reason reports give these figures. June 2, 2026 primary: 148,427 mail ballots rejected, 93,666 of them late and 43,976 for non-matching signatures. November 4, 2025 statewide special election: 159,999 rejected, 72,473 late, 69,171 non-matching signatures. November 5, 2024 general election: 122,480 rejected, 71,381 non-matching signatures. In each election total rejections exceeded 100,000, but signature mismatches alone were under 100,000, so the figures do not support "more than 100,000 ballots were rejected due to signature mismatches". The claim that more than 200,000 voters endured hassles is not documented in the guide or in these reports.

text: In the last election, more than 100,000 ballots were rejected due to signature mismatches—and more than 200,000 voters endured hassles just to get their vote to count.
